# Закрытие фазы P16

> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: P1 profiles/policies; P2 inventory; P3 gates;
terminal P6/P9/P10/P13/P14/P15 outputs. Производит: subsystem/context-first physical layout,
FQCN-invariance receipts, dev-only package-local test harnesses, no-move proof профиля A,
transfer growth map и итоговую qualification. Не производит: новый PHP vocabulary, DDL,
runtime behavior, GraphQL, package creation/deletion или framework UI.

## Произведено

- P16.1 — Intl subsystem-first physical layout: Intl physical profile B and receipt rows for Locale/Translation/Currency/Formatting/Territory.
- P16.2 — Notifications subsystem-first physical layout: Four-subsystem profile B and before/after Inbox/Delivery/Digest/Preferences spans.
- P16.3 — Tasks subsystem-first physical layout: Tasks profile B, package-local replacement harness and nonterminal D33 preparation receipt.
- P16.4 — API profile C operation surface: Profile-C operation surface and resolved-path layout receipt.
- P16.5 — API Cost and Bulk contexts: Cost/Bulk physical contexts and two use-case span receipts.
- P16.6 — API Webhooks context: Webhooks physical context and complete API profile-C layout receipt.
- P16.7 — Modules root consistency: Consistent modules root and eight-definition move receipt.
- P16.8 — CRM feature-first physical layout: CRM profile B, closed config exception, replacement test harness and move receipt.
- P16.9 — Panels research verdict and no-move proof: Clarified panels README, docs provenance and no-move profile-A receipt.
- P16.10 — Dev-only Testing boundary: Closed D33/N09, package-local test harnesses and exact positive/negative sweep receipt.
- P16.11 — Producer-adjusted compact/Profile-B matrix and Transfer growth map: Complete profile-A receipt and Transfer growth map without new directories.
- P16.12 — Structural metadata and gate reconciliation: Reconciled metadata/docs/root CHANGELOG and zero-stale-path receipt.
- P16.13 — Full structural qualification and negative proofs: `@plan/knowledge/findings-P16-receipts.json`, refreshed generated plan views and provider-neutral Next to P17 design only.

sections.title: DoR (Definition of Ready)
sections.text:
- [x] Все решения дизайна P16 зафиксированы D91–D94; `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` отсутствует.
- [x] Для каждого пакета назван producer-adjusted профиль и конкретная карта переносов.
- [x] Для каждого move-item названы use cases и правило уменьшения top-level span.
- [x] Пакеты без move перечислены явно; import-export tombstone исключён по D13.
- [x] Каждый ordinary move-item ограничен одним owning package; cross-package scope есть только
  у атомарного Testing boundary и финальных integration/gate items.
- [x] API profile C разделён на три items; ни один item не требует чтения всех 155+ файлов.
